name: ai-text-loading
title: AI Text Loading
description: A large loading word from a rotating set of thinking phrases, with a faint brightness wave running through its letters. An optional second style adds a changing status phrase and a seconds counter.
use: An AI action runs for a while and a plain spinner feels too anonymous for the wait.
avoid: The endless wave never settles and the bold oversized words overpower a small chat bubble.
a11y: Live status is announced and reduced-motion stops the wave, but the rotating phrase is hidden so only the fixed label is read. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Large bold white words centred on a dark stage, with a smaller grey status phrase and a seconds number below. The letters are evenly spaced, and some frames catch them mid-fade so parts of a word look blurred and dim.
behaves: Every interval the phrase swaps and its letters rise and unblur in a stagger. A soft opacity wave sweeps across the letters continuously, and with the counter on the seconds tick up beside the status phrase.
customise: Props set the phrase list, swap interval, an accessible label and whether a seconds counter shows; the type size and wave timing live in the source.
weight: light: A handful of animated letter spans; the wave runs in CSS off the main thread.
